article.title: ‘Conversion Drive’ sparks Hindu protest in West Bengal: Argentina missionary confronted in Hingalganj
article.summary: Hingalganj: Tensions have reportedly surfaced in West Bengal’s Hingalganj Assembly constituency after local Hindus confronted a Christian missionary from Argentina, accusing him of conducting a prolonged conversion campaign in the area and establishing house churches to reach local residents. According to the local sources, the foreign national has been living in the Hingalganj area for several months, learning Bengali and engaging with local communities. Residents have alleged that he has been attempting to convert Hindus to Christianity and has helped establish several house churches in the locality.
